package.name: rizon10s_rt_control
package.description:
Real-time (1 kHz) joint control for the Rizon 10s arm via the Flexiv RDK C++ API.
Two processes: rt_server links the RDK and no ROS, rt_bridge links rclcpp and no RDK, and they share a small block of shared memory. colcon builds everything that does not link the RDK -- rt_bridge, the shared-memory tools, the fake server and the tests -- and the three RDK programs have their own plain CMake project under standalone/. See README.md.
